verdict.rationale: Hightouch's public REST API is versioned in its URL path: the published OpenAPI spec pins servers to /api/v1, and the API guide routes requests to /api/v1 endpoints. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, a version lifecycle, or a breaking-change process, so only the versioning half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation timelines/sunset notices, version changelog or multi-version support, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: to list syncs, send a request to https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1/syncs
Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.
